decision_statement: Refund 120.00 EUR on order 8812 for the duplicate charge of 2 November 2026, under the refund policy of 1 October 2026, through the payment gateway.
context_at_decision: Ticket 4410 reports two identical charges; the support agent matched them and proposed the refund of the second.
options_considered: Wait for the card network's automatic reversal: up to 10 days for the customer.
Offer a voucher: the customer asked for the money back.
required_inputs_used: the two charges of order 8812 in the payment ledger
assumptions_depended_on: The second charge is a duplicate, not a second order.
success_criteria: One refund of 120.00 EUR, and no second one for the same charge.

consent_posture.posture_class: contract performance: refund of a charge to the customer who paid it

affirmation_record.method: Ed25519 signature over the DPS person_approval assertion

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-EXAMPLE-REFUNDS-1: the support agent (support-agent, version 5) drafted the refund proposal from ticket 4410; I reviewed it as shown in the console, approved the specification whose digest the attachment names, and I am the accountable owner of this decision.

re_decision_trigger: The customer disputes the charge with the card issuer before the refund settles.
